feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: A quick guide to Israel's high-stakes elections
entry.summary: Israel is holding its first elections since the Hamas-led attacks of 2023 triggered a chain of conflicts across the region — a quick guide the key players, issues and when to expect a result.

entry.title: Trump administration attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey again
entry.summary: The Trump administration is attempting to prosecute James Comey for what it calls a decade-old leak of classified information. Comey's lawyers immediately dismissed the effort as invalid and outside the time limit.

entry.title: Trump administration pushes for food assistance card upgrade to fight fraud
entry.summary: The proposed rule is a major step forward in addressing a form of fraud that has robbed SNAP recipients of millions.

entry.title: Judge says DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey
entry.summary: Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for around a decade. A judicial ruling finding her dismissal unlawful adds to concerns of politically motivated firings at the DOJ.

entry.title: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
entry.summary: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.

entry.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
entry.summary: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the court last year. He argued being refused Vegemite breached the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act.

entry.title: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
entry.summary: This closed-door gathering that started Monday comes about a year before Xi is expected to secure a fourth term and personnel changes to key leadership bodies.

entry.title: Redistricting isn't playing out how the GOP hoped. And, Brazil's Lula wins 4th term
entry.summary: Republicans are spending millions on the midterms, and they still may not win districts drawn to favor them. And, Brazil's Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term in a stunning political comeback.

entry.title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan
entry.summary: President Trump intensified his anti-Muslim rhetoric against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday, portraying him as a threat to national security and questioning his loyalty to the United States.

entry.title: How AI is transforming hurricane forecasts
entry.summary: Hurricane forecasters are increasingly using artificial intelligence to make predictions.
